summary.text: Jim Butler is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates who has represented District 18 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 14 from 2012 to 2020 and is a small business owner and U.S. Marine Corps veteran.

paragraphs.text: Jim Butler served in the United States Marine Corps.
His career experience includes owning a small excavation and logging business, and he previously worked in vintage vehicle restoration.
